findings.reason: The cited evidence shows a traffic drop on different sites (S-TUN-006, 008, 018) than the event location (S-TUN-001), contradicting the causal link.
The evidence for ALR-0015 lists sites S-TUN-006, S-TUN-008, and S-TUN-018, not S-TUN-001, 002, and 003.
The evidence explicitly states the event was near S-TUN-001 from 18:33 to 22:23.
The alarms (19:41-22:49, 19:42-22:44) fall within the event window (18:33-22:23), supporting the timing match.
The tool output explicitly states no maintenance was scheduled on the listed nodes during the specified window.
The anomalies explicitly list the spike values as 719 active users and 108642 MB volume for S-TUN-003.
The evidence shows a drop on unrelated sites (S-TUN-006/008/018) while the event is at S-TUN-001, failing to support the inference of a surge caused by the event.
